# v1.4 — One-command onboarding

Fourth minor release. Focus: shrinking the time from "found this repo" to
"my agent can search" to about one minute.

## Added

- **`scripts/setup.mjs` / `setup.py`** (zero-dep twins) — one-command
  onboarding:
  1. Detects agent skill directories that exist (`~/.claude/skills`,
     `~/.agents/skills`, project-level `.claude/skills` / `.agents/skills`);
     defaults to `~/.claude/skills` when none are found
  2. Installs the skill folder into them (`--dir <path>` to override,
     repeatable) — re-running updates an existing install in place; source
     copy is detected and skipped
  3. Runs the doctor health check from the installed copy and prints a
     per-engine summary
  4. Prints what to do next (talk to your agent; optional keys)
  - `--list` shows detected directories without installing
- **README Quick start** (bilingual): install → verify → talk to your agent,
  placed at the top of both READMEs.

## Compatibility

- No changes to `search`/`fetch`/`doctor` behavior; setup is purely additive.
- Zero dependencies unchanged (Node ≥ 18 / Python ≥ 3.11).
